question: Can we start coding before the hackathon day, and what do we need to submit?
answer_text: You can start building your project a week before the event. Projects must be pushed to a public GitHub repository under an open-source license. Each team gives a 10-minute presentation. Teams also need to submit a video walkthrough. The hackathon is hosted at NIT Hamirpur.

passages.text: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Hamirpur x GDG Ludhiana is a one-day in-person mini hackathon hosted at NIT Hamirpur. Teams arrive in the morning, form a team, build a small project from scratch and demo it the same afternoon. All development work must start at the event. Projects or codebases begun before the day are not eligible.
